name: vehicle-state-and-bus
title: D1 · vehicle-state-and-bus
description: VehicleState signals and the state bus: pure per-frame signals (speed in m/s and km/h, longitudinal/lateral acceleration, yaw rate, wheel speeds, steering angle, gear, collision events), a single-source-of-truth bus with subscriptions, delta-based control/camera/car maths so behaviour is frame-rate independent, telemetry publishing events plus snapshots, and UNITS_PER_METER actually applied to every displayed unit.
creator: HelongZhou
